requiredSources: PostCloseGraph.CORE_TABLES plus exchange_calendar (14 core products plus trading calendar)
acceptanceRules: same logical date and exact one-day range
latest revision per source takes precedence, including a failed newer revision
VERIFIED or contractually legal VERIFIED_EMPTY source result only
matching source contract version, calendar version, zone, and frozen scope identity
source certificate and frozen source artifact must resolve inside archive root
source certificate target must match this SQLite runtime namespace, dataset, and source instance
certificate verified row count must equal CompletionEvidence; aggregate requires at least one written core row

raw frozen artifact SHA-256 must equal its registered source fingerprint; certificate and source hashes are included in aggregate identity
file hashing is streaming and bounded by contract byte limits
VERIFIED_EMPTY is accepted only where both source contract and source certificate allow empty
runtime: Default StageExecutor routes DataReady to DataReadiness; other stages retain existing adapters. Missing or stale source evidence returns BLOCKED.
